title: Getting started with VIGAT
text: Gene activity scores single-cell ATAC-seq usually computed counting fragments fixed region every gene, gene body plus 2 kb upstream. fixed rule can miss informative accessibility actually : cell-type-specific signal may sit short promoter peak, offset annotated TSS, mixed signal neighbouring gene. VIGAT (VLM-guided gene activity quantification) chooses region gene gene, way analyst eye. marker gene draws coverage plot ±5 kb around TSS, one track per ATAC cluster, gene model called peaks; sends plots vision-language model (VLM) instructions pick one compact window captures clearest cluster-specific promoter signal; counts fragments selected windows build gene--cell matrix. happens single call VIGAT(). vignette runs VIGAT human pancreatic islet sample 15 marker genes 7 cell types.

title: Getting started with VIGAT
text: VIGAT reads OpenAI API key OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable. Add ~/.Renviron: restart R. put key scripts commit GitHub.
code: install.packages(c("Seurat", "Signac", "remotes")) if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager") BiocManager::install(c("GenomicRanges", "GenomeInfoDb", "IRanges",                        "S4Vectors", "BiocGenerics")) remotes::install_github("beijie02/VIGAT") OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key library(VIGAT) library(Seurat) library(Signac)

title: Getting started with VIGAT
text: example human islet sample GSM7618328_GSM7618327 CompassDB. object quality-controlled clustered ATAC data, cluster labels stored metadata column ATAC_cluster. Three files needed: object islet_example_atac.rds (3.9 GB), fragment file islet_fragments.tsv.gz (3 GB) index islet_fragments.tsv.gz.tbi. Download folder: Signac object stores location fragment file, point object downloaded file: object 10,093 cells 8 ATAC clusters. make results easier read, table labels cluster RNA cell type cells belong . VIGAT use labels; model sees cluster numbers.
code: options(timeout = 3600)   # large files: allow up to an hour per download base <- "https://duke.box.com/shared/static"  download.file(file.path(base, "g31hskzlm8865ojydlyjtkurwz3ao4gc.rds"),               "islet_example_atac.rds", mode = "wb") download.file(file.path(base, "637jcsxkkw4dxn8oka7k6kig6uo5d905.gz"),               "islet_fragments.tsv.gz", mode = "wb") download.file(file.path(base, "7mzirxtynqummqoflwpquq2n9r28cda7.tbi"),               "islet_fragments.tsv.gz.tbi", mode = "wb") obj <- readRDS("islet_example_atac.rds")  frags <- Fragments(obj) frags[[1]] <- UpdatePath(frags[[1]], new.path = "islet_fragments.tsv.gz") Fragments(obj) <- NULL Fragments(obj) <- frags  table(obj$ATAC_cluster)

text: cell type present sample use two three marker genes, taken cell type markers DISCO.
code: marker_genes <- c("CPA1", "CTRB1", "PRSS1",      # acinar                   "GCG", "TTR",                 # alpha                   "IAPP", "INS",                # beta                   "RBP4", "SST",                # delta                   "PECAM1", "RAMP2",            # endothelial                   "DCN", "LUM",                 # fibroblast                   "SERPINA1", "SPP1")           # ductal

title: Getting started with VIGAT
text: One call whole analysis: Inside VIGAT(): Cells cluster label removed, clusters fewer min_atac_cluster_cells cells (50 default). every cluster least 50 cells, 10,093 cells kept. gene, TSS strand taken gene annotation ATAC assay, called peaks within ±5 kb collected. coverage plots laid four genes per page uploaded model PDFs, together prompt lists gene, strand overlapping peaks. PDFs written temporary folder deleted VIGAT() returns. model returns one window per gene. VIGAT parses windows counts fragments Signac::FeatureMatrix(). VIGAT() writes nothing disk; everything comes back res. main outputs res$vigat_windows, selected window gene, res$count_matrix, gene--cell matrix fragment counts windows. run model (gpt-5.5) used 38,082 tokens took 2.1 minutes 15 genes, sent 4 PDF pages.
code: res <- VIGAT(   obj         = obj,   genes       = marker_genes,   tissue      = "Islet",   species     = "human",   cluster_col = "ATAC_cluster",   return_highlighted_plots = TRUE )

title: Getting started with VIGAT
text: res$vigat_windows GRanges object one window per gene, res$vigat_window_df holds information data frame. model also explains choice; reply kept res$diagnostics$raw_response. table combines two. 15 genes received window 1.0 1.9 kb. Fourteen anchored called peak; DCN peak overlaps informative signal, window follows coverage alone. strongest clusters named model agree cell-type labels without model seen : acinar genes (CPA1, CTRB1, PRSS1) point cluster 7, INS cluster 0 (beta), PECAM1 RAMP2 cluster 5 (endothelial), DCN cluster 4 (fibroblast).

text: VIGAT reads OpenAI key OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable. Add OPENAI_API_KEY=your_key ~/.Renviron , never put key scripts commit GitHub.
code: library(VIGAT)  # obj: a processed Signac Seurat object with an "ATAC" assay, #      gene annotation and fragment files. res <- VIGAT(   obj         = obj,   genes       = c("INS", "GCG", "SST", "PRSS1", "PECAM1", "LUM"),   tissue      = "Islet",   cluster_col = "ATAC_cluster"   # metadata column with ATAC clusters; NULL uses Idents(obj) )  res$vigat_windows        # GRanges: one selected window per gene res$count_matrix         # gene x cell ATAC counts in those windows  # Add the counts as a new assay for downstream analysis obj[["VIGAT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = res$count_matrix)

title: VLM-guided gene activity quantification for one sample — VIGAT
text: obj processed Signac Seurat object ATAC assay gene annotation. Set Idents(obj) desired ATAC clustering calling needed. genes Character vector marker gene names. tissue Tissue label injected API prompt (e.g. "PBMC"). species Species label injected API prompt (e.g. "human"). Set NULL omit prompt. cluster_col Optional. Name meta.data column use ATAC cluster assignment. NULL (default), Idents(obj) used. min_atac_cluster_cells Clusters fewer cells excluded. Default: 50. openai_model OpenAI model name. Default: "gpt-5.5". return_intermediates Logical. TRUE, also return intermediate results: TSS info, overlapping peaks, coverage plots sent model, prompt, full API response run information. Default: FALSE. return_highlighted_plots Logical. TRUE, also return one coverage plot per gene selected window highlighted. Default: FALSE.

title: VLM-guided gene activity quantification for one sample — VIGAT
text: named list: vigat_windows GRanges containing VIGAT-selected genomic windows. vigat_window_df Data frame containing selected genomic windows. count_matrix Sparse gene--cell raw ATAC count matrix generated     counting fragments overlapping VIGAT-selected windows using     Signac::FeatureMatrix(). diagnostics List containing raw_response,     genes_found, genes_skipped. intermediates return_intermediates = TRUE: list     tss_info, overlapping_peaks, coverage_plots     (named list ggplot objects), prompt, api_response     api_run_info. highlighted_plots return_highlighted_plots = TRUE:     named list ggplot objects, one per gene.
